title: Luxurious home 2 miles from Broadway
description:
This stylish place to stay is perfect for group trips. You will be staying 7 min away from Downtown Nashville, where you will discover all the best attractions of Music City!

The space
Welcome to your beautiful modern luxury stay close to main attractions in Nashville.
- This is a brand new house built in 2020. 
- Sleeps up to twelve people. 
- Four bedrooms with four queen beds, one bulk bed that includes one full and one twin bed, 3 air beds, and one couch that turns to bed. Super comfortable new memory foam mattresses. 
- Three full baths and two half baths.
- One main kitchen with everything you need and another fully stocked kitchenette on 3d floor than has microwave and cooktop. 

Tall ceilings and lots of light for a tranquil relaxing atmosphere. 

Rooftop deck with fireplace for relaxing.  ( Sorry, but we don’t provide gas. It can be provided by request only for additional $20) 

Located in Cleveland Park neighborhood, a hip up-and-coming area of East Nashville, only 8 min walk to Folk (best Italian style pizza in town), and a 4 min drive to some of the best food in town including Pharmacy burgers, Mas Tacos, Lyra, Red Headed Stranger and more. 
A short 7 minutes uber/drive to Five Points East Nashville and 8 minutes to downtown broadway. 
Also very close to attractions like Nissan Stadium and Top Golf. There’s also lots of explore in East Nashville, famous for bars, great dining, and creative artists.
